rows: Done-when 3 on the pipeline images of the head: `remote-chat-agent` (Deploy run 342, 2 min 17 s) and `leetcode-backend` report the head at `/health`. The `leetcode-backend` image was first started by hand with `wf deploy run leetcode-backend --ref 3b4a307aa` because its package had not changed since `42b1161` and the plan would not rebuild it; commit `1534e1a36` (one comment line in its `main.rs`) then made the Deploy plan build it, so the running image is pipeline-built: Deploy run 344 (68 s), `/health` reports `1534e1a36818bfc5c2d555df8aa0db0f4591a0d5` while `remote-chat-agent` stays at `3b4a307aa797eb542d7b71deca7996b6451b4ae8` (its package is unchanged). BetterStack: `server.listening` and `health.heartbeat uptimeSec=0` for `remote-chat-agent` at 22:25:19Z and for `leetcode-backend` at 22:47:51Z. Authenticated through the tailnet on the pipeline images: WebSocket 7 of 7, `leetcode-backend` routes 8 of 8 (run again on the run 344 image); the vnc gate probe all pass. The head images started on the VM host's architecture have no Node process, convert two documents (200) and transcribe five clips (200).
